kpis.label: Europe & Canada added $90B+ in 2021-price terms in 2025 (~20% YoY, NATO update); 5 Allies now expected to hit the 3.5% core-defense guideline in 2026 and 17 Allies the 1.5% broader-investment guideline, on the path to NATO's 5%-of-GDP-by-2035 pledge

Defense tech VC funding hit a new full-year record in barely five months (Crunchbase); Anduril's targeted $100B round remains unclosed a month after first being reported (Jul 24), alongside megarounds already closed by Shield AI, Saronic and Helsing

Defense Autonomous Warfare Group request, a ~24,000% jump from FY26's $225M; the CCA program's own line sits near $1B for Increment 1 initial production (Anduril & General Atomics), while a 9-vendor Increment 2 downselect is underway — Kratos remains excluded from Increment 1

kpis.sub: TRUMP DRONE TARIFFS · SIGNED AUG 13, EFFECTIVE ~SEP 3
kpis.label: Tariffs up to 100% on imported drones >25kg or with thermal imaging (25% on smaller drones/components; 15% for EU, Japan, Switzerland, Taiwan, South Korea, Liechtenstein) take effect roughly three weeks after signing — a structural tailwind for domestic makers AVAV, RCAT, ONDS and KTOS, though this week's price action shows the news is now largely priced into the smaller names

tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list.

rows.angle: Q2 2026 (Aug 3): revenue +93% YoY to $1.94B, EPS $0.41 (beat $0.33 est.), US commercial +149% YoY; FY26 guidance raised to $8.15-8.16B. rows.angle: Q2 core profit €562M (~2x YoY), revenue +70% to €3.3B, backlog above €80B; stock has held €1,175-1,220 (Aug 19) as a new Danish Navy MASS decoy contract and a ~€500M mobile-hospital deal offset the Aug 13 guidance cut to €13.7-14.2B that followed Germany cancelling the F126 frigate programme (Berlin picked TKMS's MEKO A-200 instead)
rows.watch for: The F126 loss shows program-concentration risk persists even with an €80B+ backlog; Leonardo Iveco truck-unit talks still unresolved

rows.angle: CEO Christopher Kubasik was ousted Aug 17 after a board code-of-conduct investigation; insider Sam Mehta (previously led the Space & Mission Systems and Communications segments, ~80% of revenue) was named successor immediately, with Lewis Hay III as independent chairman. The company says the exit is unrelated to financials, controls or operations and reaffirmed FY26 guidance ($23.2-23.7B revenue, $42.0B backlog)
rows.watch for: Stock fell ~4% on the news; leadership-transition risk at a name with a record backlog and a new $12B Lockheed motor framework still to execute

rows.angle: H1 2026 sales +9% to £15.8B, record £84B backlog; new $169.2M MK41 VLS contract modification (Aug 18, spanning US/Australia/Japan/Netherlands FMS) adds to the £5.9B Dreadnought award, £135M torpedo-sustainment deal and $150M USS Boxer modernization win
rows.watch for: H2 guidance follow-through; European sales now 13% of group (+30% YoY)

private_watchlist.name: Anduril
private_watchlist.note: Talks first reported Jul 24 remain unclosed a month later, as of Aug 24 — the proposed round would be more than 3x the $30.5B mark from just over a year ago and up from the $61B May 2026 round (Thrive Capital, a16z). One floated structure would commit investors now to a second, higher-priced raise within about a year if Anduril hits financial benchmarks. CEO has separately warned it's "bad to IPO in the middle of a hype cycle."

private_watchlist.name: Shield AI
private_watchlist.note: No new financing news this period (some newsroom activity Aug 5, no financial details surfaced); still marked by the $2B Series G (Mar 26, 2026) co-led by Advent International and JPMorgan's Security & Resiliency Initiative, plus $500M in non-dilutive preferred equity from Blackstone. Hivemind autonomy software; V-BAT drones.

private_watchlist.name: Saronic
private_watchlist.note: No new financing this period; continuing to scale its NVIDIA-powered autonomy stack and its Franklin, Louisiana shipyard (part of a $300M expansion) toward a stated target of 20+ autonomous surface vessels a year by 2027. Still marked by the $1.75B Series D led by Kleiner Perkins.

private_watchlist.name: Helsing
private_watchlist.note: No new financing this period; still marked by the $1.8B round closed Jul 13, 2026 (JPMorgan, Lightspeed, Iconiq) at an $18B valuation. AI software + strike drones, Europe's rearmament wave.

bear_case.title: Public-market valuations still elevated
bear_case.description: The US Aerospace & Defense industry continues to trade well above historical multiples. Palantir has rebounded to ~$179.80 even after its 52-week-high pullback, and Cathie Wood trimmed $27.2M of PLTR in August even as sell-side targets rise — a reminder that conviction is far from unanimous at these prices.

bear_case.title: Capital outrunning production — and now diluting shareholders
bear_case.description: Defense tech VC funding topped $14.6B in barely five months of 2026. On the public side, Kratos itself just raised $1.4B in a follow-on offering to fund growth — a reminder that even profitable, guidance-raising names are tapping capital markets hard, diluting existing holders in the process.

bear_case.title: Governance and program-execution risk hits even established primes
bear_case.description: L3Harris ousted CEO Chris Kubasik on Aug 17 over an unspecified conduct violation, and Rheinmetall's F126 frigate cancellation (Germany chose TKMS instead) is still working through its FY26 guidance months later — proof that record backlogs don't insulate a prime from sudden leadership or program shocks.

bear_case.title: Budget and trade politics
bear_case.description: FY27 requests aren't appropriations, and NATO's 5%-of-GDP pledge still depends on year-by-year political follow-through. The Aug 13 tariff proclamation takes effect around Sep 3 and looks largely priced into the smaller drone names already; a 9-vendor CCA Increment 2 downselect remains open with no clear selection criteria yet disclosed.

stance.basis: Weights are a share of a hypothetical 100% sleeve for THIS SECTOR only — not a share of your portfolio. Core and Speculative names carry the weight; Watch and Avoid deliberately carry 0% because the point of those groups is that you are not holding them yet.

positions.name: BAE Systems
positions.note: The new $169.2M MK41 VLS contract modification (Aug 18) adds to the £5.9B Dreadnought award, £135M torpedo-sustainment deal and $150M USS Boxer win — genuine multi-domain order momentum on top of the H1 guidance upgrade; still the most straightforward name for you to hold, UK-listed with no wrapper needed.

positions.name: AeroVironment
positions.note: A new $500M Army layered counter-drone contract adds to the earlier $400M Locust award and the Aug 13 tariff tailwind — real, compounding revenue; kept speculative rather than core given the stock's sustained run and still-unresolved securities-fraud litigation. Also sits in the Robotics sleeve — don't double-count. Needs a US wrapper.

positions.name: Kratos Defense
positions.note: Completed a $1.4B follow-on offering (16.43M shares at $84, Baird lead) on Aug 14 to fund CCA/hypersonic capacity — dilutive near-term but capitalizes growth after missing the June CCA Increment 1 award; kept speculative given the dilution and a mid-$60s price still well below the $105.62 average analyst target. Needs a US wrapper.

positions.name: L3Harris
positions.note: CEO Chris Kubasik was ousted Aug 17 over an unspecified code-of-conduct violation and replaced immediately by insider Sam Mehta; the company says it's unrelated to financials, controls or operations and reaffirmed guidance, but a sudden, unexplained leadership change is exactly the kind of unresolved question that keeps this off Core for now. Also sits in the Space sleeve via its payload work — don't double-count. Needs a US wrapper.

positions.name: Rheinmetall
positions.note: Stock has stabilized around €1,175-1,220 on the Danish MASS decoy win and a new ~€500M mobile-hospital deal, but the F126 frigate cancellation (Germany chose TKMS instead) that drove the Aug 13 guidance cut to €13.7-14.2B remains unresolved; still directly accessible via European exchange access from the UK without a US wrapper.

positions.name: Palantir
positions.note: Stock has rebounded to ~$179.80 (Aug 23) and Phillip Securities lifted its target to $215, but the multiple is still extreme against mid-90s% growth, and Cathie Wood trimmed $27.2M of PLTR in August — waiting for a more durable pullback. Also anchors the AI sleeve — don't double-count. Needs a US wrapper.

positions.name: Ondas Holdings
positions.note: No fresh operational catalyst this week beyond last week's record Q2 and Cyberhawk close; stock pulled back ~3% with the rest of the drone group even as Investing.com's analyst screen shows Ondas carrying the group's largest implied upside (111% to a $19.42 target) — margin and profitability visibility still the gating issue before this becomes a position.

positions.name: Red Cat Holdings
positions.note: Shares slid 4% to ~$11 after a 21% weekly run when the new Blue Ops Havoc maritime-autonomy partnership disclosed no contract value — the same pattern as last quarter's revenue-growth-but-consensus-miss print; headline deals without disclosed economics don't change the avoid call.
